description: Failover (F), redistribution (R) and autoscale (A) phases of the large audio mesh, each group one held step of listeners on curve 1 (five edges a region). Every scenario: a baseline, the fault at baseline_s, an observation, the restore, a settle. A kill is SIGKILL and then the unit stopped (Restart=always would bring it back in 2 s; low-latency ops D4); a crash is the SIGKILL alone, the 2 s restart (F2r). Fault sizes against five serving edges a region: at most 2 of 5 at once (D5). LL-HLS readers are needletail-reader crowds that follow steering and move; their entry points and the liveness check are nodes that no phase faults. scale-run.py run --phase-plan deploy/low-latency/phases-scale.json --group F|R|A. needs_am names what a scenario still waits for before it can pass (Phase AM items 8-11 are in the low-latency binaries since wave 8 stage 4: UDP egress in the load, live gauges, paced drain, needletail-load through /api/assignment with per-move accounting, UDP region failover); until then it runs and measures what the binaries do. deploy/low-latency/SCALE.md has the cost, the shedding order and the local proofs.

shedding: When the run's projected end passes 345 min of the lab's life (5.75 h; the watchdog's down starts at 355 min and the lab is gone at 6.0 h): first the joins of the representative steps not yet run, then what is left of the 10 min of reruns, then curve 1's c1-opus1-mixed, then half of curve 2's steps (SCALE.md), then the scenarios, the lowest `shed` first: F8, R5, F2r, R4, F7, ... ; 0 is not run until its Phase AM work lands.

schedule.description: The whole large-mesh run in six billed hours, as agreed with the referee on 22 November: no Sydney (69 nodes, $7.884 an hour), the watchdog armed for 6.0 h from the lab's creation (its down starts 5 min before), the schedule ending at least margin_min before that down. Two windows run first, with the referee's own tools on this lab (A: the wave 7 audio headline; B: 4K with GSO); then the ramps and the phase groups. A fixed block is timed by estimate (minutes); a block with `run` is the scale-run.py run command (without $COST) and is timed by `scale-run.py plan` itself, which reports the total (`schedule` in plan --json). A refused core stops the run with no retry; nothing is added past this schedule. deploy/low-latency/SCALE.md has the commands.

blocks.name: bring-up
blocks.what: lab up --without-sites sydney (69 nodes, staged), bootstrap and push in the windows' settings (one edge a region, public path, GSO on), the referee's gobuild, prepare (4K indexes of clips6-full), livekit, audio and secrets, scale-run.py prepare, and the 4K clips (five rungs, 6.4 GB) onto lon-src

blocks.name: A-headline
blocks.what: wave 7 audio headline, the referee's compare-audio.py: session scale-w7 (opus-2.5 with 1 ms Opus Custom, pcm with 1 ms PCM; about 15 min) and scale-w7-std (standard 2.5 ms Opus; about 7.5 min), lanes lkregion, nt-popus/nt-pcm (LL-HLS, -w, -h3) and nt-uc, phases baseline, joins (20 a lane) and impair (1%, 5%, burst, and the harness's 100 ms delay)

blocks.name: B-4k-gso
blocks.what: 4K with GSO, the referee's compare-run.py --lanes nt --phases throughput, rungs 2160p25, 40, 80, 160, 240 (about 80 s a rung; the sweep ends early after two rungs that reach no region whole): contributor, one edge a region, the view hosts on the public path, no simulated listeners

blocks.name: restart-e2
blocks.what: deploy restart $(scale-run.py settings --edges-per-region 2): the VLAN, two edges a region

blocks.name: restart-c1
blocks.what: deploy restart $(scale-run.py settings): five edges a region

blocks.name: start-standby
blocks.what: deploy start --nodes (the standby edges): ten edges a region

blocks.name: reruns
blocks.what: reruns of steps or scenarios that failed for reasons other than load (was 10 of phases and 30 of steps)

blocks.name: down
blocks.what: scale-run.py stop, lab down, the VLAN and leftover check

cuts: 1. joins only at representative steps: c1-pcm-udp's first step (100) and 10,000 (where five edges a region reach about 93% of their outbound cap at 1 ms PCM without Sydney), and the top of curve 1 (c1-opus25-udp's 40,000), plus all of (A): 3 ramp steps instead of 53, 66.6 min saved (437.7 min before any cut, 371.1 after this one)
2. reruns: 40 min (10 of phases, 30 of steps) cut to 10, 30 min saved (341.1 min)
not cut: c1-opus1-mixed, curve 2's steps, F, R, A and the LiveKit control
